S120_explain.description: Full tutor-layer explanation of correct answer, including short answer, tested concept, why it works, common trap, pattern recognition, and review focus.

functions.name: _buildTutorExplanation
functions.description: Constructs the 6-section tutor explanation object from question data. Extracts short answer, tested concept, why it works, common trap, pattern recognition, and review focus. Always includes official ExplanationCorrect as source grounding.

functions.name: _interpretExplanation
functions.description: Extracts a plain-language interpretation from the bank explanation. Finds the sentence with the clearest reasoning signal (because/therefore/thus/since/under/according to). Falls back to first sentence. Capped at 200 chars.

functions.name: _inferCommonTrap
functions.description: Infers a common trap from question structure. Uses wrong-answer explanations when available (scanning for trap-signal words: confuse, mistake, overlook, misclassify, etc.). Falls back to section-aligned generic traps (3 calc traps, 4 concept traps randomly selected).

functions.name: _inferPatternRecognition
functions.description: Suggests how to recognize this pattern in future questions. Returns calculation-specific guidance or section-aligned pattern maps (A-F) from a hardcoded lookup.

functions.name: _inferReviewFocus
functions.description: Suggests what to review if the learner missed this. Uses section-specific review topics. Appends topic accuracy note if available (≥2 attempts).

functions.name: _explainAnswer
functions.description: Entry point for explain action. Assembles tutor explanation sections into output lines. Determines selected choice from state.session.answers. Appends S123 Next Best Step, S124 Learning Patterns, S125 Focus Areas. Routes through _guardedSpeak in pilot environment, _speak otherwise.

functions.name: _guardedSpeak
functions.description: Safety-gated speak: validates output before publishing. Runs ensureSafeTutoringOutput, logs safety result, logs pilot usage. In pilot mode with violations, speaks sanitized version instead. When pilot off, silent validation only.

outputs: Structured explanation object with fields: shortAnswer, testedConcept, whyItWorks, commonTrap, patternRecognition, reviewFocus, sourceExplanationIncluded
Markdown-formatted lines array displayed in chat
Appended S123 next best step action plan
Appended S124 learning pattern observations
Appended S125 focus area suggestions
Safety validation result (when pilot enabled)
evidenceRequirements: Question must be set in context (currentQuestion != null)
ExplanationCorrect length > 30 chars triggers source-grounded path (else safe fallback)
Topic progress data with ≥2 attempts to show accuracy note
Case item: requires reviewQuestions entry for whatMattered/approachNote
Wrong-answer explanations (ExplanationWrong{X}) enable specific trap inference (else generic)
safetyControls: Anti-prediction: _guardedSpeak runs ensureSafeTutoringOutput (banned phrases: 'exam ready', 'will pass', 'guaranteed to pass')
Source grounding: always includes bank's ExplanationCorrect (sourceExplanationIncluded flag)
Safe fallback for thin explanations: keeps output grounded to topic/section without fabrication
Generic trap fallback: uses templated traps when wrong-answer explanations unavailable
Answer leakage check in hint context (ensureSafeTutoringOutput #2)
Hallucination check: validates pattern names against known vocabulary
Exam-mode leakage check: rejects output during active exam mode

S121_wrong_choices.description: Structured misconception coaching for each wrong answer choice. Uses official ExplanationWrong as source-ground, adds learner-centered coaching: why tempting, why wrong, misconception, how to avoid.

functions.name: _buildWrongChoiceCoaching
functions.description: Builds structured coaching for each wrong answer choice. Orders by selected wrong answer first, then alphabetically. For each choice: whyTempting, whyWrong, misconception, avoidNextTime. Tracks sourceExplanationIncluded and safeFallbackUsed.

functions.name: _inferWhyTempting
functions.description: Infers why a distractor looks plausible. Checks: stem/choice token overlap (≥2), calculation-looking numbers, common distractor patterns (absolute language, directional intuition, classification terms, COSO boundaries). Falls back to generic topic-anchored explanation.

functions.name: _inferWhyWrongFallback
functions.description: Safe fallback for why-wrong when ExplanationWrong is thin. Contrasts with the concept without fabricating details.

functions.name: _inferMisconception
functions.description: Infers the conceptual error behind choosing this option. If ExplanationWrong provides a clue, extracts a snippet around signal words (confus, mistake, overlook, misclassif, etc.). Falls back to section-aligned generic misconceptions (A-F).

functions.name: _inferAvoidNextTime
functions.description: Pattern-recognition tip for avoiding this trap next time. Calculation items get formula-first advice. Conceptual items get section-aligned tip maps (A-F).

functions.name: _explainWrongChoices
functions.description: Entry point for wrong-choices action. Gates: if unanswered active question, provides strategy only (no answer reveal). Post-answer/review: full coaching output with sections per choice. Appends S123/S124/S125. Routes through _guardedSpeak in pilot.

outputs: Per-choice coaching objects: choiceLabel, choiceText, whyTempting, whyWrong, misconception, avoidNextTime, sourceExplanationIncluded, safeFallbackUsed, isSelectedAnswer
Markdown output with sections per wrong choice
Review-mode bonus: 'Pulling it together' synthesis
Unanswered gate: strategy-only guidance (calc vs conceptual)
Appended S123/S124/S125 outputs
evidenceRequirements: Question must have Choices (multiple-choice format)
Question must be set in context
For full coaching: hasAttempted=true OR isReviewMode=true
Source-grounded: ExplanationWrong length > 10 chars enables bank-grounded path
Selection-safe context: isReviewMode || hasAttempted
safetyControls: Unanswered gate: no answer reveal for active questions (strategy only)
Safe fallback used when ExplanationWrong is thin (safeFallbackUsed flag)
Ban language check via _guardedSpeak in pilot
No prediction language in coaching text
Source-grounded when possible (sourceExplanationIncluded flag)
AllSelectionSafe flag tracks whether answer context is safe to reveal full coaching

S122_simplify.description: Plain-language coaching breakdown. Translates accounting jargon to everyday language without changing meaning. 4 sections: What this means, Why it matters, How to recognize it on exam day, Quick rule to remember.

functions.name: _buildSimplifyCoaching
functions.description: Builds 4-section simplified coaching object. Coordinates _plainLanguageTranslation, _inferWhyItMatters, _inferHowToRecognize, _inferQuickRuleToRemember.

functions.name: _plainLanguageTranslation
functions.description: Translates technical accounting language into plain English. If explanation is thin (<30 chars), provides concept framing without fabrication. Otherwise finds key sentence with signal words and runs through _simplifyAccountingLanguage. Adds second layer if explanation is rich (>150 chars).

functions.name: _simplifyAccountingLanguage
functions.description: Replaces/clarifies accounting jargon with plain-language parentheticals. ~30+ regex replacements covering: revenue/recognition, expense/cost, classification, valuation/measurement, control, budget/planning, performance, cost management, standard costing/variance, technology terms. Skips replacements where parenthetical already exists.

functions.name: _inferWhyItMatters
functions.description: Explains why this concept matters in real terms. Section-aligned significance (A-F). Calculation items get numbers-drive-decisions framing.

functions.name: _inferHowToRecognize
functions.description: Practical recognition tips for exam day. Calculation items: 3 rotating tips about formula-first approach. Conceptual: section-aligned recognition maps with keyword signals.

functions.name: _inferQuickRuleToRemember
functions.description: Short memory hook. Calculation: tries to detect formula in explanation, falls back to 3 rotating calc rules. Conceptual: section-aligned quick rules (A-F).

functions.name: _simplifyExplanation
functions.description: Entry point for simplify action. Gate: unanswered active question gets concept coaching only (no answer reveal). Post-answer/review: full 4-section simplify with correct answer reveal. Calls out wrong answer gently. Appends S123/S124/S125.

outputs: Structured coaching object: whatItMeans, whyItMatters, howToRecognize, quickRule, correctAnswerLetter, correctAnswerText, topic, sectionName, isCalculation, sourceExplanationIncluded, canRevealAnswer
Markdown output with 4 coaching sections
Unanswered gate: concept-only output with no answer reveal
Post-answer: full output with correct answer reveal
Wrong-answer callout when learner chose wrong
Appended S123/S124/S125
evidenceRequirements: Question must be set in context
canRevealAnswer = hasAttempted || isReviewMode
ExplanationCorrect length > 30 triggers translation path (else concept framing only)
Source explanation included when explanation is substantial
safetyControls: Unanswered gate: no answer reveal (concept coaching only before learner attempts)
Never invents facts — _simplifyAccountingLanguage adds parentheticals only, never changes meaning
Replacement skip when parenthetical already present (avoids duplication)
Identical-text fallback wraps with 'Think of it this way' prefix
Ban language check via _guardedSpeak in pilot
Grounded in bank explanation (preserves accounting accuracy)

S123_next_best_step.description: Generates a safe, evidence-grounded next-best-step action plan. Never predicts pass/fail or estimates readiness. Categorizes errors (calculation, formula, classification, concept confusion, terminology, distractor trap, oversight, correct, unanswered) and maps each to a specific action type.

functions.name: _generateNextBestStep
functions.description: Generates a structured next-best-step action plan. Infers error category from question data and learner answer. 9 error categories mapped to action types: targeted_practice, formula_review, computation_check, classification_practice, concept_review, terminology_review, trap_awareness, stem_re_read, advance, reinforce, general_guidance.

functions.name: _appendNextBestStep
functions.description: Appends Next Best Step section to coaching output lines. Calls _generateNextBestStep. Records recommendation via S129 _recordRecommendation. Adds contextual reinforcement notes for challenging topics. Skips specific action for unanswered items.

inputs: question.Stem — for calc detection and error inference
outputs: Action plan object: actionText, actionType (targeted_practice/formula_review/computation_check/classification_practice/concept_review/terminology_review/trap_awareness/stem_re_read/advance/reinforce/general_guidance), errorCategory, topic, section, isCalculation, isCorrect, isUnanswered, learnerAnswer, topicAccuracy, topicAttempts
Markdown section appended to parent coaching output
S129 recommendation delivery record
Contextual reinforcement notes for low-accuracy topics (accuracy < 60% and ≥3 attempts)
evidenceRequirements: Question must be provided
Error category inferred from question + answer context
For advance action type: topicData.accuracy >= 85 AND topicData.totalAttempts >= 3
For reinforcement note: topicAccuracy < 60 AND topicAttempts >= 3
safetyControls: Never predicts pass/fail or estimates readiness (stated in function comment)
Error categories are observational (calculation, formula, classification, etc.) — not judgments
Correct answer path: reinforces or advances, never overstates mastery
Unanswered path: gentle guidance only, no specific action prescribed
All action text is grounded in question data, topic, and section

S124_learning_patterns.description: Identifies safe, evidence-backed learning patterns from learner data. Returns factual observations: topic strength, persistent weakness, improvement trends, recurring misconceptions, repeated calculation misses. Never predicts outcomes.

functions.name: _identifyLearningPatterns
functions.description: Identifies up to 3 evidence-backed learning pattern observations. Categories: topic_strength (≥85% accuracy, ≥3 attempts), persistent_weakness (≥5 attempts, <60%), improving (≥4 attempts, recent ≥75%, delta ≥10), recurring_misconception (≥2 occurrences from misconceptionPatterns), repeated_calculation (≥3 calc misses in topic). Sorted by relevance order, capped at 3.

functions.name: _appendLearningPatterns
functions.description: Appends 'Patterns I'm noticing' section to coaching output. Calls _identifyLearningPatterns. Only outputs when patterns.hasPatterns is true.

inputs: question (q) — current question for topic/section context
MayLearnerState.load() — misconception patterns, learner state sessions
outputs: Patterns object: observations (array of {category, text, evidence, safe}), count, hasPatterns, dataThresholdMet
Observation categories: topic_strength, persistent_weakness, improving, recurring_misconception, repeated_calculation
Each observation: category text, evidence object, safe flag (always true)
Markdown section appended to parent coaching output
Max 3 observations, sorted by relevance order
evidenceRequirements: Minimum 3 attempts before any observation is made (minAttempts)
Each category has independent evidence thresholds (see thresholds)
Topic progress data must be available (dataThresholdMet flag)
Misconception patterns filtered to current topic with count ≥2
Calc miss count from learner state sessions ≥3
safetyControls: All observations tagged safe:true
Never predicts pass/fail or estimates readiness
Factual observations only — grounded in learner data fields
Capped at 3 observations to avoid information overload
Relevance ordering ensures most critical patterns surface first
Topic-strength observations use 'confidence anchor' language (not exam prediction)

S125_focus_areas.description: Converts observed patterns into actionable study priorities. Every suggestion is tied to evidence. Priority-ranked: high (persistent weakness), medium (calculation errors, misconception patterns), low (topic strength, improving trends). Never predicts outcomes.

functions.name: _suggestFocusAreas
functions.description: Generates evidence-based focus area suggestions. 5 suggestion types: persistent weakness (high priority, ≥5 attempts, <60%), calculation miss recurrence (medium, from current answer), misconception pattern (medium, ≥2 occurrences), topic strength redirect (low, ≥85% accuracy with weakest adjacent topic <70%), improving trend (low, ≥4 attempts, recent ≥75%, delta ≥10). Capped at 3, sorted by priority.

functions.name: _appendFocusAreas
functions.description: Appends 'Suggested focus areas' section to coaching output. Calls _suggestFocusAreas. Records each suggestion via S129 _recordRecommendation. Priority markers: 🔴 high, 🟡 medium, 🟢 low.

outputs: Suggestions object: suggestions (array of {priority, text, evidence}), count, hasSuggestions, evidenceSources
Priority levels: high (🔴), medium (🟡), low (🟢)
Evidence objects per suggestion: accuracy, attempts, threshold used, pattern info
Markdown section appended to parent coaching output
S129 recommendation records per suggestion
evidenceRequirements: Each suggestion type has independent thresholds
Persistent weakness: ≥5 attempts, accuracy <60%
Topic strength: ≥3 attempts, accuracy ≥85%, no existing persistent weakness suggestion
Adjacent topic: weakest other topic with ≥3 attempts and accuracy <70%
Improving: ≥4 attempts, recentPct ≥75%, delta ≥10
safetyControls: Never predicts outcomes (stated in function comment)
Every suggestion tied to observable evidence field
Priority system based on evidence, not speculation
Capped at 3 suggestions to avoid overwhelming the learner
Topic strength suggestions redirect to weaker areas (not complacency)
S129 records each suggestion for outcome tracking

S126_session_recaps.description: Generates structured study session recap with strongest/weakest areas, misconception patterns, progress trends, and recommended next steps. Used by _summarizeSession to produce post-session breakdowns.

functions.name: _generateSessionRecap
functions.description: Generates structured session recap from session object and topic entries. Sections: Today's practice (counts/pcts), Strongest areas (top 2), Most frequent mistakes (bottom 2 with <60%), Key misconceptions encountered (≥2 count), Progress trend (vs prior session, delta ≥10 up/down else steady), Recommended next step (weakest topic if <60%, else stretch suggestion).

inputs: sessionObj — session object with mcqs, answers, attempts
topicEntries — array of [topic, {n, c}] entries from current session
global scoreMCQ function — for correctness scoring
outputs: Recap object: { lines: [...], hasData: true, mcqPct, totalAnswered }
Markdown sections: Today's practice, Strongest areas, Most frequent mistakes, Key misconceptions, Progress trend, Recommended next step
Null when no MCQs answered (allMcqAnswered === 0)
evidenceRequirements: At least 1 MCQ answered in session
Topic entries must have n > 0 for weakest detection
≥2 sessions for progress trend comparison
≥2 misconception count for pattern display
Weak area: n > 0 AND (c/n) < 0.6
safetyControls: Session-variation disclaimer for declining trend: 'Session variation is normal — focus on the long-term direction'
No exam-prediction language
Recommended next step focuses on explanation review, not mastery claims
Strong areas use 'strongest' not 'mastered' language

S127_weekly_digest.description: Aggregates multi-session data into a longitudinal learning review. 8 sections: Practice summary, Accuracy trend, Strongest topics, Topics needing attention, Most common misconceptions, Learning momentum, Recommended weekly focus, One small win. Every claim backed by evidence. Never predicts outcomes.

functions.name: _generateWeeklyDigest
functions.description: Generates a comprehensive weekly learning digest from last 7 sessions. Computes: overall accuracy, first-to-last session accuracy trend, strongest topics (≥3 attempts, ≥70%), topics needing attention (≥3 attempts, <60%), common misconception patterns (≥2 count), learning momentum assessment, recommended weekly focus priorities, and one small win.

functions.name: _showWeeklyDigest
functions.description: Entry point for digest display. Calls _generateWeeklyDigest. Records S129 recommendations for weak topics. Routes through _guardedSpeak in pilot. Shows data-insufficient message when <2 sessions.

outputs: Digest object: { lines, hasData, overallPct, totalAnswered, sessionCount }
Markdown sections: Weekly practice summary, Accuracy trend, Strongest topics, Topics needing attention, Most common misconceptions, Learning momentum, Recommended weekly focus, One small win
Null when <2 sessions in lookback window (last 7)
Null when totalAnswered === 0
S129 recommendation delivery records for weak topics
evidenceRequirements: ≥2 sessions in last 7 sessions
≥1 question answered in lookback window
Strong topics: ≥3 attempts with ≥70% accuracy
Weak topics: ≥3 attempts with <60% accuracy
≥2 misconception pattern occurrences
First and last session accuracy available for trend
safetyControls: Never predicts outcomes (stated in function comment)
Declining trend: notes 'Session-to-session variation is normal'
Mixed-performance language: 'this is normal during active learning'
Momentum section uses observational language ('trending upward', 'building solid foundations') — not prediction
No exam readiness claims
S129 outcome tracking for closed-loop learning

S128_study_strategy.description: Converts observed patterns into evidence-backed study plans across three horizons: next session, this week, next 2 weeks. Every recommendation requires evidence. Never predicts outcomes.

functions.name: _generateStudyStrategy
functions.description: Generates a personalized study strategy. Three horizons: Next session (focus on weakest topic if <60%, else stretch strong topic, else varied practice), This week (prioritize 1-2 weak topics, drill misconception patterns, maintain strong areas), Next 2 weeks (target accuracy improvement, address misconception patterns, time-boxed re-evaluation). Evidence disclosure footer.

functions.name: _showStudyStrategy
functions.description: Entry point for strategy display. Calls _generateStudyStrategy. Records S129 recommendations for weak topics. Routes through _guardedSpeak in pilot. Shows data-insufficient message when <1 session.

outputs: Strategy object: { lines, hasData, weakTopics, strongTopics, patternCount, sessionCount }
Three-horizon plan in markdown: ▶ Next study session, 📅 This week, 🗓 Next 2 weeks
Evidence disclosure footer: 'Every recommendation above is based on your actual practice data'
Null when <1 session in lookback
Null when totalAll === 0
S129 recommendation delivery records
evidenceRequirements: ≥1 session in last 7 sessions
≥1 question answered
Weak topics: ≥3 attempts, accuracy <60%
Strong topics: ≥3 attempts, accuracy ≥70%
Misconception patterns: ≥2 occurrences for drill recommendation
safetyControls: Never predicts outcomes (stated in function comment)
Evidence disclosure: 'Every recommendation above is based on your actual practice data. No predetermined curriculum'
Time-boxed re-evaluation: 'After 2 weeks, revisit this strategy'
Specific item counts are suggestive ('15-20 items per session') not prescriptive
Conservative language: 'aim for', 'consider', 'try' — not 'must' or 'should'
No exam readiness or pass/fail language

S129_strategy_effectiveness.description: Evaluates which coaching recommendations appear most helpful based on observed evidence. Never makes causal claims. Includes outcome classification, recurrence tracking, longitudinal analytics, and recommendation quality scoring.

functions.name: _generateStrategyEffectiveness
functions.description: Generates strategy effectiveness analytics. Sections: outcome distribution (positive/neutral/contradictory), recommendations followed by improvement (≥2 positive), recommendations with no clear change (≥2 neutral), contradictory notes (≥1), previously addressed topics (deprioritized recurrence), longitudinal snapshot (1-week window). Evidence disclosure with non-causality statement.

functions.name: _showStrategyEffectiveness
functions.description: Entry point for effectiveness display. Calls _generateStrategyEffectiveness. Routes through _guardedSpeak in pilot. Shows data-insufficient message when no recommendations delivered.

functions.name: _recordRecommendation
functions.description: Records that a coaching recommendation was delivered. Thin wrapper around MayLearnerState.recordRecommendationDelivery. Hooked into all coaching paths (Next Best Step, Focus Areas, Weekly Digest, Study Strategy).

functions.name: _scoreRecommendationQuality
functions.description: Scores recommendation quality on 5 dimensions: relevance (0-3 based on type/subtype), specificity (0-3: topic + subtype + evidence fields), evidenceStrength (0-3 based on attempt count), recurrenceRate (same-topic count), followThrough (later sessions count, max 3). Composite score (max 15).

inputs: For _scoreRecommendationQuality: rec object with type, subType, topic, evidence
For _recordRecommendation: type, subType, topic, section, text, evidence
outputs: Effectiveness object: { hasData, lines, outcomeSummary, recurrence, longitudinal, evidenceSources }
Markdown sections: outcome distribution, positive/neutral/contradictory breakdowns, recurrence insights, longitudinal snapshot, evidence disclosure
Null/insufficient when no recommendations delivered
Quality scores per recommendation: { relevance, specificity, evidenceStrength, recurrenceRate, followThrough, composite, maxComposite }
Recommendation IDs from _recordRecommendation
evidenceRequirements: ≥1 recommendation delivered (hasData check)
≥2 positive outcomes for 'improvement' section
≥2 neutral outcomes for 'no clear change' section
≥1 contradictory outcome for 'notes' section
1-week longitudinal window with session data
Non-causality explicitly stated: 'No conclusion implies causation'
safetyControls: Non-causality disclaimer: 'It does NOT mean the recommendation caused the improvement. Other factors may contribute'
Never makes causal claims
Never uses prediction/readiness/confidence language
'Helpful' defined as: improvement observed after recommendation, not caused by it
Evidence sources explicitly listed
Contradictory outcomes reported transparently (not suppressed)

dispatch.name: handleAction
dispatch.description: Central action dispatcher. Routes learner actions to coaching subsystems. G6 gate blocks answer-revealing actions during CMA Exam mode. Switch cases: explain, wrong-choices, hint, simplify, similar, progress, weakness, summary, next, mymistake, recovery, digest, strategy, effectiveness, chat. Calls renderView after each action.

dispatchGates.blockedMessage: May is not available during CMA Exam mode. Submit your session first, and I'll break down your results topic by topic.

learner_state_data_layer.description: MayLearnerState — Cross-session tracking and progress layer. All exports listed below.

schema.misconceptionPatterns: Array of {pattern, count, questionIds[], _topics[], firstSeen, lastSeen}

schema.sessionSummaries: Array of session summary objects (capped at 30)
schema.challengedQids: Array of {qid, firstChallenged, lastChallenged, count, status, lastText, resolvedAt} (capped at 100)

functions.name: ensureSafeTutoringOutput
functions.description: 4 checks: exam prediction language, answer leakage in hints, hallucinated pattern names, exam-mode leakage

evidence_validators.description: S113 evidence-threshold validation for insight claims

functions.name: _assessInsightEvidence
functions.description: Builds summary of which insight claims have sufficient evidence

cross_subsystem_dependencies.call_chain: handleAction → {_explainAnswer|_explainWrongChoices|_simplifyExplanation} → _appendNextBestStep(S123) + _appendLearningPatterns(S124) + _appendFocusAreas(S125) → _guardedSpeak(S108/S109). S129 _recordRecommendation is called from _appendNextBestStep and _appendFocusAreas. S127/S128 are standalone actions (digest/strategy) called directly from handleAction.

duplicated_logic.name: Topic normalization
locations: MayLearnerState._normalizeTopic is called in: S120 (_buildTutorExplanation, _explainAnswer), S121 (_buildWrongChoiceCoaching, _explainWrongChoices), S122 (_buildSimplifyCoaching, _simplifyExplanation), S123 (_generateNextBestStep), S124 (_identifyLearningPatterns), S125 (_suggestFocusAreas), freeform handler, greeting logic, setup greeting, mini-panel, _summarizeSession
